item.title: Takehara Local Sushi in Yamaguchi — Guide
item.description: Yamaguchi’s long coastline on the Sea of Japan and Seto Inland Sea gives it superb seafood, and away from the well-known fugu of Shimonoseki, the prefecture is dotted with local sushi spots where residents eat fresh fish at honest prices. Places like this offer nigiri, seafood bowls and sashimi made with the day’s local catch — sea bream, squid, mackerel and seasonal fish — in a relaxed, unpretentious setting far from the tourist trail.
